correctness.rationale: Each covariance is the exact double sum of survival-indicator covariances, proved using independent internal-node fair coins. A Haar orthogonal basis diagonalizes the covariance, with strictly positive, strictly ordered eigenvalues off the constant nullspace; the ratio 3/4 follows by a summably dominated log-determinant limit. All stated domain boundaries and n=2 exception are handled. The standalone checker independently exhausts four bracket orders, passes 1085 exact rational assertions and provides only supplementary floating-point asymptotics.

value.rationale: A complete variance decomposition for every labelled score contrast establishes optimal extremes and a sharp condition number on an infinite family of tournament brackets. A measurable ratio 3/4 between asymptotic generalized variances of fixed and randomized seeding quantifies an effect not obtainable from known negative-association signs alone. The full dyadic spectrum and signed covariance kernel directly answer a natural multivariate dependence question.
